Daily branch orders must be submitted before 10:00 PM IST every evening to guarantee next-day early morning dispatch.
Delivered quantities are verified against the physical delivery challan. If delivery is short, the actual quantity is updated and billed accordingly.
Invoices are generated using verified customer GSTIN and business address. Prices and tax percentages are frozen at checkout so that future price updates never alter past bills.
Dada Enterprise currently distributes across Surat, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Anand, Navsari, and Mumbai branches including Adajan, Vesu, Katargam, Nanpura, Icchapore, Citylight, and others.
